mapper.sql: and ( (#{batchId} is not null and s.batch_id = #{batchId}) or (#{batchId} is null and #{batchCode} is not null and s.batch_code = #{batchCode}) or (#{batchId} is null and #{batchCode} is null and s.batch_code is null) )
mapper.select:
select l.location_id as locationId, l.location_code as locationCode, l.location_name as locationName, l.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_code as warehouseCode, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, w.warehouse_type as warehouseType, l.max_qty as capacity, (select ifnull(sum(case when s.quantity_onhand > 0 then s.quantity_onhand else 0 end), 0) from wm_material_stock s where s.location_id = l.location_id) as occupied, (select ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0) from wm_product_recpt_detail d join wm_product_recpt r on r.recpt_id = d.recpt_id where d.location_id = l.location_id and r.status in ('APPROVING', 'APPROVED') and d.detail_id <> #{excludeDetailId} ) as reserved, (select ifnull(sum(s.quantity_onhand), 0) from wm_material_stock s where s.location_id = l.location_id and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.quantity_onhand > 0
) as sameItemBatchQty from wm_storage_location l join wm_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = l.warehouse_id where l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and ifnull(l.frozen_flag, 'N') <> 'Y' order by l.location_id

select a.area_id as areaId, a.area_code as areaCode, a.area_name as areaName, a.location_id as locationId, a.max_qty as capacity, a.product_mixing as productMixing, a.batch_mixing as batchMixing, (select ifnull(sum(case when s.quantity_onhand > 0 then s.quantity_onhand else 0 end), 0) from wm_material_stock s where s.area_id = a.area_id) as occupied, (select ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0) from wm_product_recpt_detail d join wm_product_recpt r on r.recpt_id = d.recpt_id where d.area_id = a.area_id and r.status in ('APPROVING', 'APPROVED') and d.detail_id <> #{excludeDetailId} ) as reserved, (select ifnull(sum(s.quantity_onhand), 0) from wm_material_stock s where s.area_id = a.area_id and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.quantity_onhand > 0
) as sameQty, (select ifnull(sum(case when s.quantity_onhand > 0 then s.quantity_onhand else 0 end), 0) from wm_material_stock s where s.area_id = a.area_id and s.item_id <> #{itemId} ) as otherItemQty, (select ifnull(sum(case when s.quantity_onhand > 0 then s.quantity_onhand else 0 end), 0) from wm_material_stock s where s.area_id = a.area_id and s.item_id = #{itemId} and not ( (#{batchId} is not null and s.batch_id = #{batchId}) or (#{batchId} is null and #{batchCode} is not null and s.batch_code = #{batchCode}) or (#{batchId} is null and #{batchCode} is null and s.batch_code is null) ) ) as otherBatchQty from wm_storage_area a where a.location_id = #{locationId} and ifnull(a.enable_flag, 'Y') = 'Y' and ifnull(a.frozen_flag, 'N') <> 'Y' order by a.area_id
